name: Experiment comparison
description: Compare tradeoffs using an explicit reference metric.
css: .shell{padding:clamp(20px,4vw,40px);max-width:1100px;margin:auto}.eyebrow{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--primary);font-weight:750}h1{font-size:clamp(25px,4vw,38px);line-height:1.18;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:12px 0}h2{font-size:18px;line-height:1.3}p{color:var(--muted)}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,210px),1fr));gap:18px;margin-top:28px}.panel{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:22px;background:var(--surface)}.soft{background:var(--soft)}.row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.btn{background:var(--primary);border:1px solid var(--primary);border-radius:9px;color:white;padding:10px 15px}.ghost{background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);border-color:var(--border)}.tag{display:inline-block;padding:4px 9px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:99px;font-size:11px}.big{font-size:42px;letter-spacing:-.045em;font-weight:700}.muted{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.state{padding:36px}.spacer{margin-top:22px}input,select,textarea{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);padding:9px;max-width:100%}textarea{width:100%}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:13px}td,th{border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:12px 8px;text-align:left}progress{width:100%;height:12px}.steps{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.steps button{flex:1;min-width:100px}svg{width:100%;height:auto}.list{list-style:none;padding:0}.list li{border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:12px 0}@media(max-width:520px){.shell{padding:18px}.grid{gap:12px;margin-top:20px}.panel{padding:16px}.big{font-size:34px}}

tasks.name: Compare tradeoffs using an explicit reference metric.
